datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.intro: bewerby processes your application data exclusively on this device. This policy describes what data technically arises, where it lives, and what rights you have.
datenschutz.principleBody: Everything you enter into bewerby - job title, company name, contact details, salary expectations, notes, the sender details in your profile, and uploaded PDF files - is stored exclusively in your browser's local storage (IndexedDB, the Origin Private File System and localStorage). There is no server this content is sent to, received by, or stored on. The only exceptions are two features you trigger yourself (see below): the contact form transmits exactly the contact details you enter there, and importing a job ad by link transmits exactly that link. Otherwise bewerby makes no network connections at all beyond the application's initial load.
datenschutz.storageTitle: Where each kind of data lives
datenschutz.storageIndexedDbDesc: Holds every application record: job title, company, location, link to the ad, contact details, salary expectations, notes, the text of your cover letter, priority, status, tags, dates and reminders, and the history of status changes.
datenschutz.storageOpfsDesc: Holds the binary data of uploaded PDFs: job ads, the stored CV, and optionally a separate CV per application. Each application only references a file name in this store.
datenschutz.storageLocalDesc: Holds settings and your sender profile: your chosen color theme, chosen language, custom color labels, which cards are collapsed on the board, internal markers for which reminders have already been shown, and the sender details you enter in your profile for your cover letters (name, address, email, phone). Those sender details are personal data; like all other content, they never leave your device. Each entry is stored only because it is strictly necessary for a feature you explicitly use (Section 25(2) no. 2 of the German TDDDG), and none of them serves tracking. No consent is therefore required for them.
datenschutz.storageKeyNotifiedDesc: Internal marker for reminders already shown
datenschutz.storageKeyCollapsedDesc: Internal numbers of the cards collapsed on the board
datenschutz.noTrackingTitle: No cookies, no tracking, no third parties
datenschutz.noTrackingBody: bewerby does not embed any analytics or tracking services, does not set cookies for advertising or statistics purposes, and does not load content from third-party servers. Fonts are bundled with the application locally instead of being loaded from an external font service.
datenschutz.hostingTitle: Server logs at the hosting provider
datenschutz.hostingBody: When you load this page, the hosting provider's web server processes technically unavoidable access data (e.g. IP address, time of access, requested file), as is standard for any website visit. These log entries concern only the delivery of the application itself, not the application data you enter within it. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; the legitimate interest lies in delivering the application securely and reliably and in fending off attacks. The access logs are rotated daily and deleted after 48 hours at the latest. No visitor statistics are generated; log analysis is switched off in the hosting panel.
datenschutz.hostingProcessing: A data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR is in place with netcup GmbH. The servers are located in Germany; no transfer to a third country takes place.
datenschutz.rightsBody: Since all application data lives exclusively on your device, you exercise your rights to access, rectification, and erasure directly within the application: applications can be viewed, edited, and individually deleted at any time. Settings also lets you permanently delete all data in one click (right to erasure). The backup page lets you export your applications, PDFs and profile as a file (right to data portability) and import them again. For the data that does arise on the server (access logs, contact form inquiries), write to the address below: there you can request access, rectification, erasure and restriction of processing, and object to the processing under Art. 21 GDPR. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR).
datenschutz.contactFormBody: If you use the contact form, your name, email address, and message are forwarded by email to the controller. This is processed by a script on the same server that serves this page - not by a third party. It is not stored in a database, only delivered by email to a mailbox with the same hosting provider; the data processing agreement with netcup stated above applies. The web server logs the call to the script as described under “Hosting” (IP address, time, requested file, but not the content of your message); these logs, too, are deleted after 48 hours at the latest. The email is deleted once your inquiry has been dealt with, unless statutory retention obligations require otherwise. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in responding to your inquiry).
datenschutz.changesBody: This policy will be updated whenever the actual data processing changes.
datenschutz.storageKeyProfileDesc: Sender details for the cover letter (name, address, email, phone) and the reference to the stored CV
datenschutz.adFetchBody: If you paste a link to a job posting into the application form and choose “Load posting”, that link alone is sent to the bewerby.de server. The server retrieves the posting and returns the extracted text to you. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, as the retrieval happens solely on your explicit request.
datenschutz.adFetchStorage: The link is not stored, not cached and not logged. It travels in the request body (POST), not in the address bar, so that it does not appear in the web server’s access logs either. Those logs therefore show that the import feature was used, but not which posting was retrieved. The retention period for the access logs themselves is the one stated under “Hosting” above. So that the import cannot be abused as an open proxy (at most 40 fetches per hour), the server keeps your IP address together with a counter in memory for up to one hour; it is never written to disk. The legal basis for this is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
datenschutz.adFetchThirdParty: The operator of the retrieved page sees the bewerby server’s IP address, not yours. Compared with opening the link directly in your browser, this discloses less about you to third parties, not more. Your application data – entries, PDFs, profile – is never transmitted; it still does not leave your device. The feature is optional: you can paste the posting text instead, in which case no retrieval happens at all.

nutzungsbedingungen.title: Terms of Use
nutzungsbedingungen.intro: These terms of use apply to using bewerby. By using the application, you agree to them.
nutzungsbedingungen.scopeBody: bewerby is a free, personal project for managing job application documents. There is no contractual relationship and no entitlement to any particular availability or functionality.
nutzungsbedingungen.serviceBody: bewerby runs in the browser and processes all application data exclusively on the user's own device (see the Privacy Policy). It is not a cloud service with user accounts.
nutzungsbedingungen.dataResponsibilityBody: Since all application data is stored exclusively in the local browser, it is irrecoverably lost if browser data is cleared or a device is changed or fails, unless backed up beforehand. Creating your own backups via the Backup page is the user's own responsibility.
nutzungsbedingungen.availabilityBody: There is no entitlement to continuous availability, error-free operation, or continued development of bewerby. Access may be restricted or discontinued at any time without notice.
nutzungsbedingungen.liabilityBody: Use of bewerby is at your own risk. No liability is assumed for data loss, missed application opportunities, or other damages arising from use of the application, to the extent permitted by law. This does not apply to damages arising from injury to life, body, or health, or damages based on intent or gross negligence.
nutzungsbedingungen.changesBody: These terms of use may be updated if bewerby's scope of features changes. The current version is always available on this page.

landing.headline: Your applications stay on your device.
landing.lead: bewerby is a kanban board for job applications. No account, no tracking, and your entries never leave the device.
landing.step1Body: Title, company, contact. Or hand over the job ad as a PDF, text or link and let bewerby read the fields.
landing.step2Body: Write the cover letter in the editor, take the CV from your settings. Export both as PDF.
landing.step3Body: From draft through sent to offer. You set your own reminders.
landing.dataBody: Entries live in your browser's IndexedDB, attached PDFs in OPFS, your profile in localStorage. Clear your browser data and the applications are gone. That is what the file export under Backup & Sync is for.
